title: Chiplet die pad geometry (pins.json)
description: Schema for a GEOMETRY pins.json: the reconciled, footprint-derived or hand-authored die pad map that interposer-pnr's pin-list reader (pads.load_pin_list) consumes to place bumps. Structural validation only. What makes a file GEOMETRY is the presence of dbu_um and per-pin coordinates (required below), NOT an enumerated source_type: source_type is an open, self-describing vocabulary (kicad_footprint, gds_extracted, hand_authored, ...), so a new geometry producer never has to edit this schema. A name-review artifact (source_type pin_review, no coordinates) fails this schema on the missing geometry, so a geometry consumer refuses it. dbu-based: every *_dbu value scales by the file's own dbu_um. The um-based black-box padmap ('pads' + bbox_um) is a DIFFERENT artifact with its own schema (blackbox_padmap.schema.json). Cross-field invariants (unique (name, pad_index); pad_index contiguity; die_bbox agreement with the .chiplet dimensions) are checked by the consumer, not here.

version.description: Contract version. Structural only: WHICH versions a consumer accepts is the shared version policy of docs/VERSION_POLICY.md (same major, minor at or below supported accepted; same-major higher minor accepted with a warning; different major refused; PATCH ignored), applied by chiplet_format_io.check_contract_version. Supported: 1.0. The bare integer 1 is the LEGACY spelling of "1.0", still emitted by existing pin-list producers; it is deprecated and will be removed one minor after every producer writes the string form, per the deprecation rule in the policy. New emitters write the string.

source_type.description: Self-describing producer kind (open vocabulary), e.g. kicad_footprint (footprint_to_pinlist), gds_extracted (reconcile), hand_authored (a hand-written fixture). Geometry is established by dbu_um plus per-pin coordinates below, not by this value; a name-review artifact (source_type pin_review, no coordinates) fails this schema on the missing geometry. A consumer may still special-case a known non-geometry source_type for a clearer error message.

dbu_um.description: Database unit in um; every *_dbu value scales by this. Never defaulted by the consumer.

die_bbox_dbu.description: Optional die GDS bounding box in the file's dbu_um; present for a bbox_center die, absent for a gds_origin die. Malformed is a hard error in the consumer, never a silent drop.

name.description: Pad name. Never inferred from array position.

pad_index.description: Orders same-name pads (a rail); a bump binds to (name, pad_index). Never inferred from array position.
